products.name: Microsoft Licensing Cost Governance — EA, CSP & True-Up Readiness — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish Microsoft licensing cost governance across EA and CSP — a clear model of what you own, true-up readiness, renewal planning, and cost controls to right-size commitments. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Govern Microsoft licensing across EA and CSP — and never fear a true-up again

Microsoft licensing is a moving target: an Enterprise Agreement here, CSP subscriptions there, annual true-ups, and renewals that arrive with surprises. Without governance you over-buy to be safe or under-license and risk a shortfall. This solution establishes Microsoft licensing cost governance across EA and CSP — a clear model of what you own under each agreement, true-up readiness, renewal planning, and the cost controls to right-size commitments with confidence.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the EA vs. CSP models, how true-ups work, the cost-governance cadence, and how entitlement counts map to deployment and growth.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID, admin/billing access, EA/CSP agreement details, usage/deployment data, procurement alignment) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory agreements and entitlements, map deployment/growth, model true-up exposure, set renewal and right-sizing decisions, establish a governance cadence and KPIs, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — entitlement/assignment discovery, true-up-exposure validation, a license position and cost report, safe remediation of mis-assignments, and a governance-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Microsoft licensing under control across EA and CSP — a known license position, true-ups that hold no surprises, and right-sized renewals — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MSLICGOV-Discovery.ps1 — read the deployed Microsoft licensing position from the tenant
    • MSLICGOV-Remediation.ps1 — safely remove a mis-assigned license from specified users
    • MSLICGOV-Report.ps1 — license-position and utilization report per product (Microsoft Graph)
    • MSLICGOV-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the governance-scope groups for pilot and estate
    • MSLICGOV-Validation.ps1 — forecast EA true-up exposure (assigned vs committed baseline)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
